ideas.pitch: An agentic knowledge-capture system that interviews departing engineers, indexes their undocumented workflows into a local vector store, and acts as an interactive onboarding agent for new hires.
ideas.title: AgentLifecycle: Autonomous Onboarding & Knowledge Transfer Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a universal developer and engineering manager pain point with multi-agent orchestration, directly mirroring winning patterns from similar agentic workflow hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An agentic GitHub app that triggers on build failures or runtime exceptions, traces the root cause across multiple files, generates unit tests, and submits a verified pull request.
ideas.title: GitMedic: Autonomous CI/CD and Runtime Error Repair Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates real-world utility by saving hours of developer debugging time, scoring high on practical execution and live-demo impact.

ideas.pitch: A self-improving semantic routing proxy that categorizes incoming agent queries using kNN exemplar matching, dynamically directing them to the most cost-effective local or frontier model with automated LLM-judge writebacks.
ideas.title: SemanticRoute AI: Training-Free Adaptive LLM Gateway
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high-performance systems engineering with tangible cost-saving metrics, appealing directly to technical judges looking for clever optimization hacks.

ideas.pitch: A federated Model Context Protocol (MCP) server architecture that securely connects disparate clinical databases to specialized AI agents while enforcing strict data governance and audit trails.
ideas.title: K-Agent Clinical: Federated Multi-Agent Medical Data Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles complex enterprise architecture and privacy compliance, setting the project apart from standard wrapper apps through deep systems integration.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous database companion agent that inspects relational schemas, auto-generates semantic embeddings for unstructured text columns, and translates natural language business queries into optimized SQL operations.
ideas.title: TOON-SQL: Auto-Embedding RAG & Query Agent for Relational Databases
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers immediate, tangible value for database administrators and data analysts by bridging natural language interfaces with production relational backends.
